title: Deep cross-peer 3D evidence reconciliation and fast qualification sequence
scope: Current open-source DWG/DXF and ACIS peer capability boundaries
Independent semantic and native-consumer evidence requirements

method.kind: Read-only review of ODA v5.4.1 §24, official project documentation/source pages, current release/issue pages, and existing local plans
method.limitations: Peer main-branch pages and issue reports are discovery/runtime-bound evidence, not normative format contracts. The LibreDWG #1411 and ACadSharp #1195 reports remain build-specific and were not reproduced. No external semantic or native-consumer result was produced.

sources.revision: Open Design Specification v5.4.1; local copy inspected 2026-10-17
sources.observed: Section 24 describes the AcDs byte-stream container, segment/data indexes, per-record object handles, inline data threshold and blob pages. SAB syntax is outside its scope. §24.2.2.7.1 distinguishes reader omission of schema-search data from writer interoperability: AutoCAD ignores a stored entity if required search data is absent.
The entity's modeler data uses group 1 and optional repeated group 3 strings, followed by a separate soft-owner history-object handle (group 350).

sources.revision: Open issue report pinned by its author to 0.14.8593 / commit prefix 8a1ae764
sources.observed: The report describes an ezdxf-authored AC1032 REGION with a 5,489-byte SAB payload that loses its AcDs carrier and geometry through the specified LibreDWG conversion route. It is a peer-specific negative route, not a positive pair or a result for all current builds.

The API limits goals to simple/known ACIS structures, says unsupported nodes load as NONE_ENTITY with data loss, maps SAT v700 to R2000-R2010 and SAB v21800 to R2013/R2018, and limits mesh projection to flat polygonal faces. It provides no ACIS kernel.

sources.revision: Latest reviewed signed release v3.8.0 at 3a1c66b
sources.observed: The release does not claim ACIS DXF writer support. Open PR #1240 is outside the release; issue #1195 reports omission on 3.4.9 and does not prove latest-release behavior.
A project maintainer says stock FreeCAD DXF import cannot read proprietary ACIS blobs; this is distinct from the external DWG-converter-to-DXF workflow and optional third-party modeler add-ons.

sources.revision: Mutable current repository/docs and issue reports reviewed 2026-10-17
sources.observed: The add-on has a separate SAT/SAB parser and FreeCAD Part route, but shares OCCT kernel lineage, documents unsupported geometry, and has open reporter issues for DXF/SAB/shell failures. It does not decode DWG AcDs associations; inspect the Python eval path before untrusted input.
Extensible DXF mode exposes bounded raw ASM/transform information but does not create OGR solid geometry.
ACIS SAT/SAB exchange is listed among commercial components, not the open-source OCCT core.

assessment.evidenceRule: Container framing, entity-to-record ownership, exact carrier bytes, payload parser completeness, B-rep semantics, and named consumer acceptance are separate evidence grades.
assessment.peerRouteRule: No reviewed open-source peer supplies one independently qualified end-to-end DWG/DXF-to-valid-ACIS-solid route. Pin and score each peer only for its documented operation/profile.
assessment.negativeControlRule: LibreDWG #1411 is usable only as a pinned loss-detection negative route; it cannot provide a positive AC1032 AcDs sample.
assessment.testSpeedRule: Use existing generated fast local tests per implementation slice. Run at most the selected optional peer/native questions at the existing composed checkpoint; unavailable routes are NOT_RUN/NOT_AVAILABLE and do not block local work.
assessment.fixtureRule: No external drawing is committed. Use already-authorized samples or temporary controls created locally from scratch.
